description: Guard registry (GRD-003 item ④). ADMISSION RULE: every test file that acts as a guard MUST be listed under `guards`, and MUST declare at least one negative test (a test that fails when the guard itself is weakened). The admission guard (tests/guard_admission.rs) fails when: (a) a guard-shaped file under tests/ is NOT registered here, or (b) a registered guard declares negative tests that do not exist as `fn` in that file. `debt` lists guards that do not yet have negative tests — explicit, not silent; each entry needs an anchor (the card/task that will clear it). Lowering this list is an authorized action; never delete an entry to make CI green.

guards.purpose: forbidden dependency edges + hotspot ledger drift + full coverage
per-model capability table self-consistency + CAPABILITIES.md generated-block equality
cargo package artifact allowlist (fail-closed on command failure)
API-002 classification freeze vs docs/api-inventory.json (loosening a classification must red)
consumer-facing JSON wire shapes (rename/remove/add field must red)
Provider/LlmError/RetryProvider behaviour freeze (4xx/429 must not be retried)
agent-facing docs/JSON validity, dangerous phrases, examples README ↔ Cargo.toml
H-4: gate hygiene — a test's verdict must come from LOGIC, not from the clock or process-global state (no unlocked `env::set_var`/`remove_var`; short-timeout latency verdicts are refused)
